translations.text: Do you believe in God the Father almighty? And in his Son, Christ the Savior? And in the Holy Spirit?

Do you believe that the three are one God almighty, who created heaven and earth? Now say: I confess to God the Father almighty and to all his [?], and that I did not honor [?] my mother as I should have,
and that I did not love my neighbors as I should have, and that I did not love my wife and my children and my disciples as I should have, and did not teach them as I should have.
That I did not honor the holy Sundays and the holy Mass as I should have [?]. That I stole, and [?] stolen goods.
That I did not visit the sick and did not comfort the sorrowful. That I did not settle quarrels that I could have settled.
That I said more [?] true and [?] than I should have. That I believed what I should not have believed: [?] visions, unrighteous [?], of unrighteous [?] places.
[?] unrighteous. That I [?] my [?]. That I did not love bishops and priests and men of God as I should have. That I spoke more and kept silent more than I should have.
That I defiled and made myself unclean with lusts and with evil desires and with evil thoughts more than I should have.
Of all this, and of much else that I did against God's will and against what was right for me, whether I remember it or do not remember it, whether I did it sleeping or waking,
whether I did it by day or by night, whether I did it willingly or unwillingly, whatever of all this I did against God's will, [?] and to you [?]
